_comment: Cold-resume questions a fresh agent must answer from the fixture ALONE. `expect` = canonical keys BOTH arms are judged against (same question, same right answer). `unwrapped` = the literal phrases carrying each fact in fixture-unwrapped/notes.md — the offline fairness/discrimination anchors for the un-wrapped arm, which phrases facts differently than the koan docs. selftest proves each answer is derivable from its corpus (fair) and that removing its source lines makes it underivable (the test discriminates).
